newSkillDescription: Create one of ChatShell's own skills. It is saved as a folder with a SKILL.md and syncs to your other devices.
noSkillsDescription: Create a skill, or install one by sharing a skill link in a chat.
notOnThisDeviceDescription: This skill was synced from another device. Its files appear here once they finish downloading.
readOnlyHint: This skill belongs to another source. Edit it in its own folder.
folderNameHelp: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. The folder lives in ~/.chatshell/skills/.
folderNameInvalid: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only, and don't start with a dot.
deleteDescription: The skill folder moves to ~/.chatshell/skills/.trash and the skill is removed from all your synced devices.
editSkillDescription: Edit this skill's SKILL.md. Changes sync to your other devices.
failedToOpenFolder: Failed to open the skill folder
